reason: An anime-themed UI customization plugin that applies five light/dark artwork skins, offers a switcher and transparency slider, and stores those preferences locally.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供五套支持明暗模式的动漫主题、皮肤切换器和透明度调节功能。
summaries.en: Adds five anime-inspired light and dark themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a skin switcher and adjustable transparency.

capabilities: serves bundled artwork through a host route
overrides web UI theme tokens and backdrop styling
provides a skin switcher and transparency control
persists skin and transparency preferences in browser localStorage
